market_value_contract.side: Home spread line, in points; negative means the home team is favored. The difference is model_fair_value minus closing market_value.
market_value_contract.total: Game total, in points. The difference is model_fair_value minus closing market_value.
market_value_contract.moneyline: Home win probability. market_value must be de-vigged from a complete paired home/away closing quote; difference is a probability-point difference.
market_value_contract.fair_value_boundary: These are existing model-originated estimates, not independently calibrated or validated fair prices.

market_number_semantics.side: Market number is the home-side spread in points; negative means home favored.
market_number_semantics.total: Market number is the game total in points.
market_number_semantics.moneyline: Market number is not used; the closing value is the normalized home win probability derived from a paired quote.

snapshot_contract.opening_definition: Use the provider-identified opening quote and market-open timestamp when available. If the provider does not expose the true open, record only its first observed quote, mark the basis as first_quote_in_provider_archive or first_observed_by_own_capture, and leave market_open_at_utc blank; never relabel first observed as true market open.
snapshot_contract.closing_definition: Last authorized quote captured in the fixed 15-minute pre-kickoff interval [kickoff minus 15 minutes, kickoff). Exact UTC kickoff and capture timestamps are required.
snapshot_contract.reference_source_rule: Predeclare one operator/source and settlement contract for the market; opening and closing rows must match. Do not splice prices across operators.
snapshot_contract.write_rule: Append-only. Reject a duplicate snapshot ID; never overwrite an opening or closing row.
snapshot_contract.unknown_rule: Missing values serialize as null/empty cells, never as zero or an inferred quote.

source_status.odds_route_scope: The checked NFL odds path only; a 404 does not establish that no operator feed exists.
